method.value: Combine ALMACAL catalogue with ACSC; add redshifts and classification

analysis_steps.goal: Cross-match with PCNT and compare photometry

method.value: Cross-match within 3 arcmin outside GAL070 mask; compare mean ALMA flux densities with MTFX photometry, frequency-shifted with fixed spectral indices

evidence.quote: The comparison with PCNT flux densities was made using the mean values and adopting the standard deviation, summed in quadrature with the calibration uncertainty, as an estimate of the uncertainty.

key_parameters.value: Band 7 to 353 GHz with S∝ν^-0.45; Bands 8/9 to 545 GHz with S∝ν^-0.62

findings_qualitative.value: Good consistency of MTFX and ALMA photometry above PCCS2 90% completeness limits; Eddington bias below

evidence.quote: We found good agreement between the ALMA and the MTFX photometry above the 90% completeness limits given by (cite: PCCS2).

limitations_admitted.value: Planck and ALMA data are non-simultaneous so blazar variability adds dispersion

evidence.quote: Blazars are known to be strongly variable and *Planck* and ALMA measurements are non-simultaneous.

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Small: catalogue tables only (MB) if using released ACC; raw ALMA calibrator data would be very large
reproducibility.score_reason: Catalogue-level analysis is simple and data are public, but ACC construction and many details rely on other papers and no code is given.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Underlying catalogues are inherited from other works and the statistical procedures are only briefly described, although results are numeric.
